name: Requim
tagline: The operating system for the modern funeral enterprise.
positioning: Requim unifies case intake, disposition logistics, and family billing across every location in your funeral group — on one auditable platform.

hero.h1: Run every location on one dignified platform.
hero.sub: Requim connects intake, transfer logistics, disposition, and family invoicing across your entire funeral group — so directors spend hours with families, not spreadsheets.

features.title: Unified case intake
features.description: Capture first-call details once and sync them to every downstream form, permit, and vendor request across all your homes.

features.title: Disposition logistics
features.description: Coordinate transfers, crematory slots, and cemetery scheduling with real-time capacity and chain-of-custody tracking.

features.title: Family billing that reconciles
features.description: Generate GPL-compliant statements, itemized contracts, and installment plans that post straight to your ledger.

features.title: Compliance by default
features.description: Every signature, permit, and authorization is timestamped and audit-ready for state boards and FTC reviews.

features.title: Multi-location visibility
features.description: Roll up case volume, at-need vs. pre-need mix, and margin across regions from a single executive dashboard.

features.title: Vendor network sync
features.description: Push orders to crematories, vault suppliers, and floral partners with confirmed pricing and delivery windows.

testimonials.quote: We consolidated eleven locations onto Requim in a quarter. First-call to signed contract dropped from three days to under four hours, and our board audits finally take an afternoon instead of a week.
testimonials.name: Margaret Ellery

testimonials.quote: The chain-of-custody tracking alone justified the platform. Our directors trust it, our controllers trust it, and our compliance officer stopped chasing paper.
testimonials.name: Daniel Krupa

testimonials.quote: Usage-based pricing meant we onboarded without a capital request. Requim scales with our case volume instead of forcing us to guess a seat count.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

pricing.blurb: For independent funeral homes standardizing their core workflow.
For multi-location operators who need rollups and vendor sync.
For regional and national groups with complex compliance needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Requim is the enterprise platform for funeral groups — unifying care, logistics, and finance so families are served with dignity and precision.
